title: Garage operations base
summary: Start in a garage and use the van route map to travel with an engine-start driving transition.
notes: Start new joins and respawns in a shared concrete GridMap garage.
Use the van with E, controller Use or touch USE to visit the casino, basement garage or street district.
Play a short driving screen and engine sound before server-validated travel.
Return through Operations Garage on the casino north promenade or follow GPS directions.
